description:
From the fz-kdt.120 research (2026-09-02, d2a5f3510). A free type variable
intersects every concrete kind to `none`, so a union member that carries one
is silently DELETED:
  {:cont,{[int],int}} | {:halt,{[int],int}}  ∩  ({:cont,b} | {:halt,c})          = none
  {:cont,{[int],int}} | {:halt,{[int],int}}  ∩  ({:cont,{[int],int}} | {:halt,c}) = {:cont,{[int],int}}   <- :halt arm gone
  (int,{[int],int}) -> {:cont,..}|{:halt,..}  ∩  (a,b) -> {:cont,b}|{:halt,c}     = (int | a0, a1 | {[int],int}) -> none
jobs/semantic.rs refine_contract_inputs guards only the WHOLE-input empty case
(if is_empty(refined) { input }), so the partial erasure passes as a
"refinement", keys the callee's activation on the narrowed row, and the callee's
entry_dispatch loses the arm. Measured consequence (prototype with facts-only
contract params): List.reduce_while_step/3 keyed [.., {:cont,{list,int}}, ..]
instead of [.., {:cont,{list,int}} | {:halt,{list,int}}, ..], its entry_dispatch
lost the whole :halt arm (46 canon lines) and Enum.take([1,2,3,4,5], 3)
printed the whole list -- 15 behaviour movers, all early-halt (take, find,
find_index, count, reduce_while). contract.rs narrow_args_to_clause ALREADY
skips var-carrying positions (:232); refine_contract_inputs does not: two
sibling narrowing paths of one feature disagree. WARNING: adding the same skip
to refine_contract_inputs alone at HEAD takes 00277_enum_tier0_fixture from
green to rc=101 -- HEAD's correctness currently DEPENDS on narrowing closure
arguments by a var-carrying arrow surface. Direction: Types::intersect must
treat a free variable as `any` for the purpose of set operations (a variable
denotes an unknown SUBSET, and intersecting with an unknown cannot delete),
or refuse the operation; then the guard becomes unnecessary and the 00277
dependency must be understood (what does it rely on?). Blocks the principled
facts-only parameter policy for @spec instantiation (fz-kdt.120's residue).
title: Types::intersect deletes a union member whose surface member carries a free type variable, and refine_contract_inputs consumes the erasure as a refinement
